title: Store object manifest
description: ASSESS-PAGE-1: what a top-level object in the run store IS. Until now everything in the store was a 'run', so scanning an estate created a run that then sat in the run list looking like an abandoned migration - an assessment does not belong in the run list. An assessment is not a failed run. It answers a question on its own, it gets re-run and compared, it is the thing that gets reviewed and signed off, and it is READ-ONLY and deliberately broad where a migration writes and should be as narrow as the estate allows. This manifest is what tells the two apart, so it is a contract rather than an informal file.

kind.description: Which of the two things this object is. The Assessments page lists assessments; the Runs page lists migrations. An object with no kind cannot be placed on either, which is why this is required rather than defaulted - a default would silently put every old object on one of the pages.

runId.description: This object's own id, and its prefix in the store. Named runId rather than id because it is what every existing document already calls it; renaming it would touch every reader for no gain.

createdBy.description: The signed-in person who started it, when the app did. Null when a command line did, which is a fact rather than a gap.

fromAssessment.description: MIGRATIONS ONLY: the id of the assessment this migration was planned from. This is the traceability the product did not have - a migration could not say what it was based on, or whether that assessment had been reviewed. Null is allowed for a migration planned before assessments were separable.

scope.description: ASSESSMENTS ONLY: what was scanned, so the page can say so without opening the assessment itself.

project.description: PROJECT-1: the project this run belongs to - the prefix it lives under. Null for a run outside any project (LOOSE-RUNS-WORDS-1: the command line can make one). The project's NAME is not repeated here: it lives once in project.json, because a name copied onto every member is a name that can disagree with itself.

allOf.description: An assessment cannot have been planned from an assessment.
A migration has no scan scope of its own - it inherits the assessment's.
